title: Grateful Dead Live at Carthay Studios on 1966-03-19

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of the historic Pico Acid Test (3‑19‑66) with crisp audio and a raw early‑Dead blues set highlighted by Jerry’s soaring leads on Heads Up and Midnight Hour.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑preserved SBD source – clear, fairly stereo and surprisingly clean for a 1966 document. Musically the show is more valuable as a historic snapshot than a peak performance; it features early blues numbers with standout moments from Jerry Garcia on Heads Up, Stormy Monday Jam and Midnight Hour, while Bob Weir’s vocals are occasionally off‑key.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the excellent soundboard quality (≈4.5/5) but describe the musical performance as average to good (≈3.5/5); weighting these gives an overall rating around 3.8.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, upfront and fairly stereo SBD; some listeners note a slightly softer/more mono feel compared to other ’66 recordings but overall very listenable with no major drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Dead blues set with a mix of covers and nascent originals; the flow is straightforward but lacks the seamless segues of later shows.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for incendiary leads on Heads Up, Stormy Monday Jam and Midnight Hour; his guitar sits high in the mix but adds excitement.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals noted as slightly off‑key on a few numbers.
